capabilities: Convert speaker-line and inline timestamps into clickable play buttons in reading view
Seek and play or pause the note's embedded audio at the clicked timestamp
Auto-highlight and follow the current timestamp while audio plays
Partition documents with multiple audio files into independent sections
extras: Works only in reading view, not edit or Live Preview mode; requires at least one embedded audio file for the plugin to activate. The plugin page notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Chinese documentation is available.
problem: Obsidian's embedded audio cannot be controlled from text: transcription notes offer no way to jump playback to a timestamp by clicking it.
summary: Audio transcription viewer that turns timestamps in notes into clickable play buttons that seek and play the embedded audio file.
